note: Administered wording is the Italian CFQ-7 transcribed verbatim from S1 Appendix of the source paper (Donati MA, Berrocal C, Bernini O, Gori C, Primi C (2021) PLOS ONE 16(2):e0246434, CC BY 4.0), 'Italian version of the Cognitive Fusion Questionnaire-7', read with python-docx (the docx table cells; the appendix has 7 unnumbered item rows and a header row of 7 anchors). The study's own S1 Dataset (.sav, .s003) was opened first: it carries NO variable labels for any CFQ column (only 'ID' -> 'Codice ID') and NO value labels at all, so data_labels was unavailable. IRW item codes CFQ1..CFQ7 ARE the .sav column names (data/donati_2021_cfq7.py melts them unrenamed), so there is no positional or generated-code step. The appendix rows carry no numbers, hence paper_order: row i is read as canonical CFQ-7 item i. That reading is corroborated by two independent CC BY sources that print the English CFQ items keyed to the same codes -- PMC11875431 Appendix A (CFQ1, CFQ2, CFQ4, CFQ5, CFQ6, CFQ7 verbatim) and PMC13082997 (Item 3 'I over-analyze situations to the point where it's unhelpful', item 4 'I struggle with my thoughts') -- and by the source paper itself, which quotes 'My thoughts cause me distress or emotional pain' and 'I tend to get very entangled in my thoughts' as CFQ examples. English in the _translated columns is the CFQ's own English wording (Gillanders et al. 2014, Behavior Therapy 45:83-101), i.e. the original of which the Italian is a translation, not a rendering made here; the 1-7 anchors Never/Very seldom/Seldom/Sometimes/Frequently/Almost always true are the CFQ/AAQ-II scale's published English anchors and translate the Italian one-for-one (the paper's Table 1 note independently confirms 1 = 'Never True' to 7 = 'Always True'). instructions and section_prompt are left blank: the S1 Appendix publishes only the item grid, and no framing text was invented. Rights checked before transcribing: the rights holder's page (contextualscience.org/cfq, Gillanders) states 'The CFQ is free to use for clinical and research purposes, permission is not needed' -- no non-commercial clause, no redistribution bar and no fee is stated, so none of the itemtext_standard.md 2026-09-04 rights rules fire; the copy shipped here came from the CC BY 4.0 PLOS appendix in any case. Separately flagged in notes: the live table's cov_population labels are inverted (a response-data defect).
